templates.name: b2b-crm
templates.description: A lightweight B2B CRM with a daily sales overview, accounts, activities, follow-ups, and a review-first pipeline.
agentPrompts: Add a new company and its primary contact from these notes.
Show me the accounts with follow-ups due and summarize the latest activity.
Log this customer interaction and schedule the next follow-up.
Add this opportunity to the pipeline and show me deals by stage.

templates.name: busa-cms
templates.description: A WordPress-style admin for a website's Posts, Pages, Categories, and Tags — the exact four Bases the busabase-cms-sdk reads.
agentPrompts: Write a post announcing this week's release and publish it.
Which pages are published without an SEO description?
Move the pricing page back to draft until finance confirms the numbers.
Give me the snippet for wiring my Next.js site to this Folder.

templates.name: busa-email
templates.description: Inbox triage, human review, and trusted execution — an approval-first email desk.
agentPrompts: Triage this morning's mail and draft replies for anything high priority.
List the reviews still waiting on me, newest first.
Summarise what changed in the inbox since yesterday.

templates.name: busa-product-hub
templates.description: Product & certification hub for export/trade sellers: catalog/SKU master data, pricing, inventory, channel status (Amazon/Shopify/TikTok Shop/eBay), content readiness, compliance notes, lifecycle state, a certificate expiry tracker (CE/FCC/RoHS/UN38.3/UKCA), and an approval-gated review queue (channel publish approvals, price-change review, quality holds, lifecycle decisions, and unsourced spec claims). The AirApp itself only ever decides on a review item (approve/request_changes/block) directly onto its own record -- it never creates a product, channel, inventory, or certificate row.
agentPrompts: Show me which certificates are expiring soon or already expired.
Summarize the latest products and flag what needs my attention.
Open Busa Product Hub and show me the items that need review.
